exceptions.reason: Public GitHub ingress bypasses API-access and CSRF middleware. Remote-mode enforcement rejects missing secrets; configured secrets require X-Hub-Signature-256 verification before queuing. Without enforcement and secrets, this receiver accepts unsigned requests: do not expose that configuration publicly.

Public Stripe ingress bypasses API-access and CSRF middleware. Stripe-Signature is verified when provider secrets exist; remote-mode signature enforcement rejects missing secrets. Without enforcement and secrets, this receiver accepts unsigned requests: do not expose that configuration publicly.

Public generic ingress bypasses API-access and CSRF middleware. A configured per-webhook secret is verified against X-Webhook-Signature; remote-mode signature enforcement rejects records without a secret. Without enforcement and a secret, this receiver accepts unsigned requests: do not expose that configuration publicly.
